title: Randomized decision-tree complexity
statement: Let $f$ be a function on inputs of length $n$ over a finite, nonempty alphabet. Its randomized decision-tree complexity is the infimum of the worst-case costs of randomized decision trees that compute $f$ with zero error.
caveat: The supplied definition of randomized decision tree specifies zero-error computation, but the definition of cost is absent from the supplied statement.
